title: LoopStage
description: One role's execution within an Iteration. Runs on a Job under a Role. Normative.

role.description: Role name; MUST be within the executing persona's allowed_roles. Missing/undefined at dispatch ⇒ stage blocked + Critical (Loops.md §4). The stage runs rooted in the loop session's workspace (Foundation §4.4).

verdict.description: Persisted gate verdict; approval requires both booleans true and no Critical/Important findings.
